label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'inventory.py' — a small dict-based inventory module with a module docstring and these documented functions: 'add_item(store, item)' appends an item; 'qty_chk(item, n)' returns whether n <= item["stock"]; 'find_item(store, name)' returns the matching item. Also write 'tests/test_inventory.py' covering 'qty_chk' and 'find_item'.
